keyword.en: concrete pump main cylinder and swing cylinder
keyword.zh: 混凝土泵主油缸和摆缸名称没有写什么

title.en: What Main-Cylinder and Swing-Cylinder Names Omit
title.zh: 主油缸和摆缸的名称省略了什么

description.en: The parts list names a main-cylinder seal and a swing-cylinder seal. It does not print bore, stroke or a repair sequence.
description.zh: 配件清单写出主油缸密封和摆缸密封。它没有印缸径、行程或维修顺序。

h1.en: What Main-Cylinder and Swing-Cylinder Names Omit
h1.zh: 主油缸和摆缸的名称省略了什么

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery names a main-cylinder seal and a swing-cylinder seal among concrete pump parts in Xingtai. A swing-arm ball is named as well. These words tell you the circuit has a main cylinder and a swing cylinder. They do not print cylinder bore, piston stroke or a step-by-step repair. Pump performance stays on the pump page: power, output, pressure and distance. A seal name is not a service manual.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵配件里写出主油缸密封和摆缸密封，也写出摆臂球头。这些词说明回路里有主油缸和摆缸。它们没有印缸径、活塞行程或分步维修。泵的性能仍在泵的页面上：功率、产量、压力和距离。密封件的名称不是维修手册。

body.en: The published names are main cylinder seal, swing cylinder seal and swing-arm ball, plus the S-tube and piston names on neighbouring part pages. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not add a cross-section drawing with dimensions in the pump specification tables.
body.zh: 已公布的名称包括主油缸密封、摆缸密封和摆臂球头，以及相邻配件页上的 S管和活塞名称。河北品锦机械没有在泵的规格表里附加带尺寸的剖视图。

body.en: No bore, no stroke, no swing angle and no torque. Do not fill those blanks from a general textbook or from another brand. If a size is required, open the part page for the sizes that page actually lists, or ask /en/contact/. This article does not repeat size tables.
body.zh: 没有缸径，没有行程，没有摆角，没有扭矩。不要用通用教科书或其他品牌去填这些空白。如果需要尺寸，请打开配件页看该页实际列出的尺寸，或询问 /zh/contact/。本文不重复尺寸表。

heading.en: The pump sheet is still the performance sheet
heading.zh: 泵的参数页仍然是性能页

body.en: A main-cylinder name does not change Electric 40's 23 MPa or Diesel 30's 20 MPa. Those are outlet-pressure cells on concrete pumps. Keep the assemblies and the performance cells in their own places.
body.zh: 主油缸这个名称不会改变电动40的 23 MPa 或柴油30的 20 MPa。那些是混凝土泵上的出口压力格。总成和性能格要留在各自的位置。

answer.en: No. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not print them on the concrete pump sheets.
answer.zh: 没有。河北品锦机械没有在混凝土泵参数页印出它们。

question.en: Does a seal name include a repair sequence?
question.zh: 密封件名称包含维修顺序吗？

answer.en: No. The catalogue names the part. It does not print steps.
answer.zh: 不包含。目录点了零件名称。它没有印步骤。

answer.en: On the concrete pump page that states outlet pressure or pumping pressure.
answer.zh: 在写明出口压力或泵送压力的混凝土泵页面上。

question.en: Is the swing cylinder the same as the S-tube?
question.zh: 摆缸和S管是同一个零件吗？

answer.en: The catalogue gives them different names: swing-cylinder seal and S-tube seal.
answer.zh: 目录给了它们不同的名称：摆缸密封和 S管密封。
